channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Top Wall Street advisor stunned by national debt: 'A fantastic amount of money to have borrowed'
item.description: Rockefeller Capital Management's Greg Fleming told David Rubenstein that the country's fiscal situation is his primary concern.

item.title: Ukraine applies corporate KPIs to military strategy, RAND says
item.description: Ukraine uses business-style performance metrics to maximize Russian casualties and economic damage, potentially weakening its resolve, according to RAND.

item.title: Kalshi CEO clashes with ex-Rep. George Santos over prediction market dispute
item.description: Santos was fined $35,000 after the CFTC found he manipulated Kalshi contracts related to his State of the Union attendance.

item.title: Iran conflict benefits world's largest shipbroker with record profits from Hormuz volatility
item.description: Geopolitical unrest boosts demand for such firms as clients grow more desperate, a maritime trade expert noted.
